question: What does the Zed Pro checkout and the dashboard.zed.dev billing page ask for beyond a GitHub sign-in (card at once, billing address, tax ID), and can a trial start with only the GitHub login?
why: zed.dev/upgrade-plan?plan=pro answered a GitHub login wall to the broker and no account may be created, so the checkout is unverified: behind a sign-up. The docs say paid plans are paid by credit card or another supported method and the trial needs no credit card.
